critical_code_review_comments: MovingNoButton: share button rect is hardcoded (bottom-right 230x96) rather than querying the actual ShareButton via ref/getBoundingClientRect. If ShareButton size/position changes, avoidance breaks. Consider passing a ref or querying '[data-testid="share-button"]' inside dodge().

MovingNoButton onClick also triggers dodge — a real click never registers on NO (fine by design), but there is no keyboard accessibility (Enter/Space would dodge and re-focus can be lost). Non-critical for this playful stage.
Stages.jsx FinalRequestStage: notsure view lacks a Label/kicker for visual hierarchy consistency with the question view (minor).

score row values are plain strings like '∞ / 10' — the label 'Chances of forgiveness' does NOT contain '/ 10' as stated in the request; instead shows "it's in you." which matches config. Uniformity is 'value is a big serif number/expression' rather than strict 'x / 10' string — matches intent from request.

Chapter01 sticker: verified position:static and in-flow BUT computed background on the outer wrapper picked up transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)); the dark bg is set via inline style on the child motion.span (StickerNote). Consistency-wise it renders correctly (iteration_3 already confirmed rgb(74,59,44) bg on the actual sticker element).

Score stage has data-testid=score-row-{0..4}. Apology has data-testid=apology-line-{0..2}. Notsure page has data-testid=notsure-line-{0..3} and notsure-back. Final has final-yes / final-notsure (static, no moving button).
